subject: ela
intro: A drawing can go with our words to help show what we mean. A good picture matches what we are telling about. Kindergartners add a drawing that fits their words.

items.prompt: You tell about your red kite. What should your drawing show?

steps: The drawing should match the words.
I talked about a red kite.

items.prompt: Why do we add a drawing to our words?

steps: A drawing helps show what we mean.
solution.answer: To help show and understand our words.

items.prompt: You wrote about a dog at the park. Which drawing fits: a dog at a park, or a boat on the sea?

steps: The drawing must match the words.
The words are about a dog at the park.
So draw the dog at the park.

items.prompt: You tell about a yellow sun. Draw a ____.
You wrote about a cat. Draw a ____.
